4 September 2026

The Berkeley Group Holdings plc
(the "Company")

Transactions in own shares

The Company announces that during the period from 28 August to 4 September 2026 ("the Disclosure Period"), it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 5.6110477936 pence each ("Shares") through Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays"), in accordance with the authority granted by shareholders at the Company's Annual General Meeting on 5 September 2025. All Shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE").

The Shares purchased during the Disclosure Period will be cancelled and will not be held as Treasury shares. Following the cancellation of these Shares, the Company has 91,195,553 Shares in issue (excluding Treasury shares). This is the figure which should be used by shareholders as the denominator when determining whether they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in the Company under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
